summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Phase E1 - Event Bus + Automation Engine + WhatsApp Adapter. All backend APIs (61/61 tests) and frontend UI elements tested successfully. Mock-first WhatsApp integration working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Authentication for all users (owner, ops, driver)
Backend: Automation rules CRUD (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) - 8 seeded rules active
Backend: Automation metadata endpoints (event-types, stats)
Backend: Event Bus end-to-end (lead.created → automation runs with send_wa action)
Backend: Event triggers (quotation.sent, booking.confirmed, payment.recorded)
Backend: Idempotency (no duplicate runs with same dedupe_key)
Backend: WhatsApp config & templates (owner-only, masking secrets)
Backend: WA simulate-inbound (creates conversation, triggers wa.inbound event)
Backend: WA webhook (verification with challenge, inbound processing)
Backend: Inbox WA messaging (opt-in/out, cost tracking, session window)
Backend: RBAC (driver denied 403, ops has automation access, owner-only for wa/config)
Backend: Reset defaults endpoint (installs 8 rules)
Frontend: Automation page - 6 KPI cards render (Aturan Aktif, Eksekusi Hari Ini, Total Eksekusi, WA Terkirim, WA Masuk, Estimasi Biaya WA)
Frontend: Automation tabs - Rules tab with toggle switches
Frontend: Automation tabs - Runs tab with status filter
Frontend: Automation tabs - Events tab with event type filter
Frontend: Inbox - 'Simulasi WA' button opens panel with form fields
Frontend: Inbox - WhatsApp bar shows session info, cost, opt-in/out buttons
Frontend: Inbox - Template dropdown available for WA conversations
Frontend: Inbox - Message composer working
Frontend: Settings - Automation section with rules list, toggle, 'Tambah Aturan' button
Frontend: Settings - Automation rule dialog with form fields (name, event, actions, conditions)
Frontend: Settings - WhatsApp section with provider select, config fields, save button
Frontend: Settings - WhatsApp templates section with add/edit/delete functionality

additional_notes.mock_implementation: WhatsApp MockProvider is correctly implemented and active. All WA messages show 'sent' status with mock wa_message_id (wamid.mock_...) and cost tracking. Meta Cloud provider is correctly stubbed (returns 'fase E6' message when selected).
additional_notes.event_bus: Event emission is defensive (doesn't fail transactions). Idempotency working via dedupe_key. All 8 default automation rules are seeded and active.
additional_notes.rbac: Permissions correctly enforced: driver gets 403 on automation endpoints, ops_admin has automation access but not wa/config (owner-only).
additional_notes.ui_quality: All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes. Forms, dialogs, and interactions working smoothly. Indonesian language UI consistent throughout.
additional_notes.screenshots: 4 screenshots captured showing KPIs, tabs, simulate panel, automation settings, and WhatsApp configuration.
